title: Fields in software engineering
body:
[[CS]] (Computer Science)

[[Information Technology]]

Week-one scope setting: where software engineering sits between the two. [[CS]] studies what
computation is and can do, software engineering builds systems under schedule and budget
constraints, and [[Information Technology]] runs and supports the systems once they exist.
The boundaries are fuzzy and nobody polices them; the point is only that "programming" is a
small part of any of the three.

See [[Projects in software engineering]] for the constraints half, and [[Metrics]] for the
recurring attempt to make the discipline measurable.
